subject: HorizonAI technical follow-up: deep-dive options & calendar constraints
body:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murphy <amurphy@horizonai.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@horizonai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: HorizonAI technical follow-up: deep-dive options & calendar constraints

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Helpful to hear more about HorizonAI's latency targets and the primary pain points you hit at 20k concurrent sessions. Per our notes, a focused technical deep-dive will help validate topology, caching strategy, and the rollout constraints for private deployment.

Proposed formats (pick one):
- Single 90-minute session: architecture walkthrough + Q&A (recommended if your infra + SRE will attend together)
- Split sessions: 60-minute infra & architecture deep-dive + separate 30-minute security/compliance review with your Security lead (if they prefer a narrow scope)

Potential windows (PT time):
- Tue Aug 26: 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Aug 27: 08:30–10:00 PT
- Thu Aug 28: 13:00–14:30 PT (backup)

Attached is a short agenda and proposed packet to help people prep: horizon-deep-dive-agenda.pdf.

Ask: can you confirm which format you prefer and which of the proposed windows works for your team? Also let us know attendees (names + roles) so we can include the right Redwood engineers.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timezones.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Murphy <amurphy@horizonai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@horizonai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:03:12 -0400
Subject: Re: HorizonAI technical follow-up: deep-dive options & calendar constraints

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the write-up — that looks good. A couple quick constraints from our side:
- Our Security team prefers a focused 30-min review (they won't sit through a 90-min architecture session).
- NetEng (Nathan) needs to be on any architecture conversation; SRE (Sam) should join the end for rollout questions.
- Preferred times (PT): Tue Aug 26 10:00–11:30 or Wed Aug 27 08:30–10:00.

If you can do a split (60 + 30) that's ideal: 60 for infra + architecture (Nathan + Sam), 30 for Security (Priya + one Security engineer).

Also attaching our current network diagram for reference (Horizon-Prod-network-v2.pdf).

Alex
Director of Platform, HorizonAI
amurphy@horizonai.com | +1 206-555-0147

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murphy <amurphy@horizonai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@horizonai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 12:30:45 -0400
Subject: Re: HorizonAI technical follow-up: deep-dive options & calendar constraints

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Alex. We can absolutely split the session. Suggested plan:

Option A (recommended):
- 60 min: Architecture deep-dive (Karthik + Ben) — topology, KV cache strategy, latency hotspots
- 30 min: Security/compliance focused review (Marissa + Karthik) — data residency, audit logs, KMS integration

If that works, let's book the 60-minute block for Tue Aug 26 10:00–11:00 PT, followed immediately by a 30-minute security call 11:00–11:30 PT. That keeps folks from joining twice. Ben — are you available for 10:00–11:30 PT on Tue 8/26?

I'll attach a lightweight network map we plan to reference (prelim-network-diagram.png) and a short agenda.

Karthik

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murphy <amurphy@horizonai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:05:10 -0400
Subject: Re: HorizonAI technical follow-up: deep-dive options & calendar constraints

Alex —

Ben is available Tue 8/26 and can cover the architecture portion. We'll plan for the split schedule Karthik proposed (60 + 30 back-to-back).

Action items on our side before the session:
- I'll send a calendar invite for Tue Aug 26 10:00–11:30 PT with the meeting rooms + recording enabled.
- Karthik will circulate the agenda + diagrams (attached).
- Ben will prepare notes on expected throughput tests and a short slide on fallbacks.

Attaching an internal briefing doc for Ben: engineer-briefing-notes.docx.

If you prefer a single 90-minute meeting instead, we can combine — just say the word.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Murphy <amurphy@horizonai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@horizonai.com>, Nathan Lin <nlin@horizonai.com>, Sam Reed <sreed@horizonai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: HorizonAI technical follow-up: deep-dive options & calendar constraints

Thanks — Tue 8/26 10:00–11:30 PT works. We'll be there with:
- Alex Murphy (Director of Platform)
- Priya Kapoor (Security lead)
- Nathan Lin (NetEng)
- Sam Reed (SRE)

A couple small asks:
- Please enable recording and share the link after the call.
- Can you include a brief runbook slide showing expected failover behavior for the private deployment?
- We'll upload the Horizon-Prod-network-v2.pdf to the invite thread for your engineers to review.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Alex

---
Attachments referenced: horizon-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (Redwood agenda), prelim-network-diagram.png (Redwood reference map), engineer-briefing-notes.docx (internal)
